topology.purpose: Control plane, client/test runner, static UI

products.name: TemporalStore
products.summary: Online temporal feature engine for high-cardinality windows, filtered event state, long sequence features, and persisted serving.

products.name: MatrixDB
products.summary: Multi-tenant KV/profile engine for large online profile objects, hot-key serving, cache-plus-storage, and Redis-compatible access.

products.name: MatrixKV
products.summary: Transactional distributed KV service with timestamp coordination, partitioned storage, strong consistency, and release deployment paths.

latestRun.name: AWS 30-minute service smoke
latestRun.notes: Core modules stayed stable; TemporalAggregate writes currently fail with a response-size check and need follow-up debugging.

issues: TemporalAggregate secondary replay/read visibility must be fixed before aggregate secondary reads are trusted.
Two-replica table creation currently hits Missing condition info in one path.
Prometheus scrape is live for TemporalStore; MatrixDB and MatrixKV need their own target registration.

matrixdb.title: Multi-tenant control
matrixdb.body: Designed around tenant and namespace isolation so profile serving can scale without mixing ownership or quota signals.

matrixdb.title: Large online profiles
matrixdb.body: Targets profile objects, hot keys, and cache-plus-storage access patterns where simple in-memory-only caching becomes expensive.

matrixdb.title: Protocol flexibility
matrixdb.body: The observation page tracks Redis-compatible and direct service paths separately so migration issues are visible.

matrixdb.title: Placement health
matrixdb.body: Shard placement, rebalance state, failover, and storage movement are the first-class runtime signals to wire.

matrixkv.title: Strong consistency path
matrixkv.body: Tracks transaction commits, timestamp allocation, partition state, and leader health for correctness-first KV workloads.

matrixkv.title: Partitioned serving
matrixkv.body: Observability should separate master, timestamp service, proxy, and partition-server signals.

matrixkv.title: Release packaging
matrixkv.body: Client and server packages should expose dependency loading and direct SDK/proxy readiness.

matrixkv.title: Scale tests
matrixkv.body: Read/write latency, retry pressure, and CPU should be collected under fixed concurrency levels for each node type.
